'''Phoenix Squadron''' was a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] squadron consisting of [[A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter/Legends|B-wing starfighters]]. They were part of a failed attempt to [[Attack on the Compellor|destroy]] the [[Immobilizer 418 Interdictor-class Heavy Cruiser|Immobilizer 418 cruiser]] ''[[Compellor/Legends|Compellor]]''. Their role was to attempt to destroy the ''Compellor'' by disabling her weapon systems with [[Mag-pulse warhead/Legends|mag pulse]] warheads, then attack with volley of [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedos]]. [[Viper Squadron (Rebel Alliance)|Viper Squadron]] provided starfighter cover for Phoenix Squadron during the attack on the ''Compellor''. Unfortunately for the Alliance, both squadrons were lost in the engagement.
